name: Vilnius University
about: Lithuania's oldest and largest university, founded in 1579. Known for strong research and a wide choice of English-taught programmes in the heart of the capital.

requirements.academic: HSC (or equivalent) with good grades in subjects related to the programme. A bachelor's degree for master's programmes.
requirements.english: IELTS 6.0–6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80+ / PTE or Duolingo accepted for some programmes.

deadline: Usually in spring for September intake

name: Kaunas University of Technology (KTU)
about: One of the largest technical universities in the Baltic states, with a modern campus and strong links to industry and tech companies.

requirements.academic: HSC (or equivalent) with Mathematics for engineering programmes. A related bachelor's degree for master's.
requirements.english: IELTS 5.5–6.0 / TOEFL iBT 65+ / MOI may be accepted.

deadline: Usually late spring for September intake
